verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 21.10
verses.english: Linked Discourses 21.10

verses.pali: 1. Bhikkhuvagga
verses.english: 1. Monks

verses.pali: Theranāmakasutta
verses.english: Senior In Name Only

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Rājagaha, in the Bamboo Grove, the squirrels’ feeding ground.

verses.pali: Tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu theranāmako ekavihārī ceva hoti ekavihārassa ca vaṇṇavādī.
verses.english: Now at that time there was a certain mendicant who was Senior in name only. He lived alone and praised living alone.

verses.pali: So eko gāmaṁ piṇḍāya pavisati eko paṭikkamati eko raho nisīdati eko caṅkamaṁ adhiṭṭhāti.
verses.english: He entered the village for alms alone, returned alone, sat in private alone, and focussed on walking mindfully alone.

verses.pali: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṁsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdiṁsu. Ekamantaṁ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṁ etadavocuṁ:
verses.english: Then several mendicants went up to the Buddha, bowed, sat down to one side, and said to him,

verses.pali: “idha, bhante, aññataro bhikkhu theranāmako ekavihārī ekavihārassa ca vaṇṇavādī”ti.
verses.english: “Sir, there’s a certain mendicant who is Senior in name only. He lives alone and praises living alone.”

verses.pali: Atha kho bhagavā aññataraṁ bhikkhuṁ āmantesi:
verses.english: So the Buddha addressed one of the monks,

verses.pali: “ehi tvaṁ, bhikkhu, mama vacanena theraṁ bhikkhuṁ āmantehi:
verses.english: “Please, monk, in my name tell the mendicant Senior that

verses.pali: ‘satthā taṁ, āvuso thera, āmantetī’”ti.
verses.english: the teacher summons him.”

verses.pali: “Evaṁ, bhante”ti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato paṭissutvā yenāyasmā thero tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṁ theraṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: “Yes, sir,” that monk replied. He went to Venerable Senior and said to him,

verses.pali: “satthā taṁ, āvuso thera, āmantetī”ti.
verses.english: “Reverend Senior, the teacher summons you.”

verses.pali: “Evamāvuso”ti kho āyasmā thero tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinnaṁ kho āyasmantaṁ theraṁ bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: “Yes, reverend,” that monk replied. He went to the Buddha, bowed, and sat down to one side. The Buddha said to him:

verses.pali: “saccaṁ kira tvaṁ, thera, ekavihārī ekavihārassa ca vaṇṇavādī”ti?
verses.english: “Is it really true, Senior, that you live alone and praise living alone?”

verses.pali: “Evaṁ, bhante”.
verses.english: “Yes, sir.”

verses.pali: “Yathā kathaṁ pana tvaṁ, thera, ekavihārī ekavihārassa ca vaṇṇavādī”ti?
verses.english: “But in what way do you live alone and praise living alone?”

verses.pali: “Idhāhaṁ, bhante, eko gāmaṁ piṇḍāya pavisāmi eko paṭikkamāmi eko raho nisīdāmi eko caṅkamaṁ adhiṭṭhāmi.
verses.english: “Well, sir, I enter the village for alms alone, return alone, sit in private alone, and focus on walking mindfully alone.

verses.pali: Evaṁ khvāhaṁ, bhante, ekavihārī ekavihārassa ca vaṇṇavādī”ti.
verses.english: That’s how I live alone and praise living alone.”

verses.pali: “Attheso, thera, ekavihāro neso natthīti vadāmi.
verses.english: “That is a kind of living alone, I don’t deny it.

verses.pali: Api ca, thera, yathā ekavihāro vitthārena paripuṇṇo hoti
verses.english: But as to how living alone is fulfilled in detail,

verses.pali: taṁ suṇāhi, sādhukaṁ manasi karohi; bhāsissāmī”ti.
verses.english: listen and apply your mind well, I will speak.”

verses.pali: “Evaṁ, bhante”ti kho …pe….
verses.english: “Yes, sir,” he replied.

verses.pali: “Kathañca, thera, ekavihāro vitthārena paripuṇṇo hoti.
verses.english: “And how, Senior, is living alone fulfilled in detail?

verses.pali: Idha, thera, yaṁ atītaṁ taṁ pahīnaṁ, yaṁ anāgataṁ taṁ paṭinissaṭṭhaṁ, paccuppannesu ca attabhāvapaṭilābhesu chandarāgo suppaṭivinīto.
verses.english: It’s when what’s in the past is given up, what’s in the future is relinquished, and desire and greed for present incarnations is eliminated.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, thera, ekavihāro vitthārena paripuṇṇo hotī”ti.
verses.english: That’s how living alone is fulfilled in detail.”

verses.pali: Idamavoca bhagavā.
verses.english: That is what the Buddha said.

verses.pali: Idaṁ vatvāna sugato athāparaṁ etadavoca satthā:
verses.english: Then the Holy One, the Teacher, went on to say:

verses.pali: “Sabbābhibhuṁ sabbaviduṁ sumedhaṁ,
verses.english: “The champion, all-knower, so very intelligent,

verses.pali: Sabbesu dhammesu anūpalittaṁ;
verses.english: is unsullied in the midst of all things.

verses.pali: Sabbañjahaṁ taṇhākkhaye vimuttaṁ,
verses.english: He’s given up all, freed in the ending of craving:

verses.pali: Tamahaṁ naraṁ ekavihārīti brūmī”ti.
verses.english: I declare that man to be one who lives alone.”

verses.pali: Dasamaṁ.
